items.title: Awesome Testing
items.content_text:
### Software / Service Virtualization

*   [s3-test-server](https://www.npmjs.com/package/s3-test-server) - S3-compatible server for tests that runs inside your Node.js test process or standalone via npx, and works with any SigV2/V4 client (AWS SDK v2/v3, AWS CLI, curl).

items.title: Open Source Mac Os Apps
items.content_text:
### ⏱️ Productivity (165) / ✏️ Text (19) * [akou (⭐14)](https://github.com/GeiserX/akou) - Records calls and meetings, transcribes them on-device with speaker labels, and lets Claude Code or Codex question a call over MCP. **Languages:** TypeScript Rust **Website:**
Screenshots

* [ParrotFlow (⭐22)](https://github.com/znat/parrotflow) - Scriptable local dictation that uses the text on your screen to fix names, and your rules to format numbers, dates, and links. **Languages:** Swift Python **Website:**
Screenshots

* [littleguys (⭐39)](https://github.com/herval/littleguys) - WhatsApp-style app for talking to your AI agents (OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and any ACP agent). **Languages:** Rust TypeScript **Website:**
Screenshots

* [WolfClip (⭐8)](https://github.com/RakushkaTOP/wolfclip) - Win+V style clipboard history with search, filters, pins and instant paste into the app you were typing in. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [Posato (⭐5)](https://github.com/dees91/posato) - Blocks the websites and apps you choose for a timed pause, now or on a schedule, with optional end-to-end encrypted sync to iPhone through iCloud. **Languages:** kotlin Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 🎵 Audio (72) * [JackMate (⭐6)](https://github.com/zinc75/JackMate) - JackMate is a native macOS app to start, configure and patch the JACK audio server, with a visual patchbay, saved studios and a menu bar mode. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 📊 Menubar (177) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Local Transcriber (⭐11)](https://github.com/teconomix/local-transcriber) - Menu bar app that records meetings and calls and transcribes them locally with Whisper and pyannote speaker recognition, with dictation into any app. **Languages:** Swift Python **Website:**
Screenshots

* [TICS (⭐8)](https://github.com/yestoall/tics) - Menu bar app that plays mechanical keyboard sounds as you type, and mouse sounds as you click, drag and scroll. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [Pullo (⭐5)](https://github.com/jordan-cod/pullo) - Your GitHub pull requests and Actions runs in the MacBook notch, with alerts when CI fails, a PR is approved or a review is requested. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 👨‍💻 Development (61) * [Alchemist Coder (⭐5)](https://github.com/Alekla0126/alchemist-coder) - Desktop app for Claude Code and Codex that shows every agent and subagent live, searches your coding-agent history and runs agents on local models. **Languages:** TypeScript **Website:**
Screenshots

### 📺 Terminal (30) / ✏️ Text (19) * [tern (⭐56)](https://github.com/your-moon/tern) - Native SSH client written in Rust on GPUI, with saved hosts, a command picker, SFTP browser, split panes, port forwards and encrypted sync. **Languages:** Rust **Website:**
Screenshots

* [writui (⭐6)](https://github.com/aakashns/writui) - A terminal Markdown writing app with a local encrypted vault, automatic saving, and named versions. **Languages:** Rust **Website:**
Screenshots

### 🛠️ Utilities (234) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Cellar (⭐11)](https://github.com/tuhage/Cellar) - Homebrew manager for formulae, casks, and services that previews what brew will change before it runs. **Languages:** Swift **Website:** [https://github.com/tuhage/Cellar (⭐11)](https://github.com/tuhage/Cellar)
Screenshots

* [StableBar (⭐14)](https://github.com/Seb-GRAF/StableBar) - Customizable menu bar replacement with themes, widgets, popups and AeroSpace, yabai or OmniWM workspaces. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [OS-intent (⭐8)](https://github.com/vdk888/os-intent) ![macOS 14.0++](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS-14.0+%2B-blue) - Learns how you work and puts your likely next action one key away, with every outward action behind a confirm panel. **Languages:** Swift Python
Screenshots

* [Aman Check (⭐33)](https://github.com/MidZai/aman_check) - Dated, honest condition report for a used Mac: locks, battery, SSD and guided hardware tests. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 🖼️ Images (23) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Siliconed (⭐14)](https://github.com/gwenn-ha-dev/Siliconed) - Local AI image generation and instruction-based image editing on Apple silicon, with Civitai LoRAs. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

### 💻 IDE (16) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Volt (⭐16)](https://github.com/LeulAria/VOLT) - Open-source AI code editor built on VS Code (Code - OSS) that runs Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Kimi over ACP, with hunk-level keep/undo of agent edits. **Languages:** TypeScript **Website:**
Screenshots

### ⚙️ System (49) / ✏️ Text (19) * [FanPilot (⭐2)](https://github.com/zyvren/FanPilot) - Fan control and temperature monitor for Apple Silicon Macs, with Auto Boost rules, custom curves, a fail-safe helper and a CLI. **Languages:** Swift
Screenshots

### 🎬 Video (30) / ✏️ Text (19) * [Jutsu Studio (⭐23)](https://github.com/jutsuhq/jutsu-studio) - Unofficial Higgsfield client for creating AI videos and images with Seedance, Kling and Genjutsu, with every result kept on your disk. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

* [Swapjutsu (⭐6)](https://github.com/jutsuhq/swapjutsu-seedance-character-swap) - Character swap for videos with Seedance 2.5 or Wan 2.2 Animate, with on-device preparation on Apple silicon. **Languages:** Swift **Website:**
Screenshots

items.title: Awesome Amazon Seller
items.content_text:
### Software and Tools

*   [BulkBarcode Generator](https://bulkbarcode-generator.com) - Makes FNSKU, UPC, EAN-13, Code 128 and QR labels in bulk from an Excel or CSV file, and exports print-ready PDF rolls for thermal printers. Runs in the browser. Free plan.
*   [CorpusIQ](https://www.corpusiq.io) - Connects ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity read-only to Amazon Seller, Shopify, GA4, QuickBooks and 40+ other systems, and answers questions about the business with the source of each number. From $29.95 a month, with a 30-day free trial.
*   [Fbaleaks](https://fbaleaks.com) - Audits FBA inventory and reimbursement reports in the browser. Finds lost or damaged units that Amazon did not reimburse, sorts SKUs to keep, reprice or remove, and drafts appeal letters. Free tools and a one-time paid audit.
*   [PixVibe](https://pixvibe.ai/tools/remove-background) - Browser-based background remover that exports product photos on a white or transparent background, with tools to compress, resize and crop images. Free for single images, with no account.
*   [TranslateMyImage](https://translatemyimage.com/amazon-image-translator) - Translates the text inside product images, infographics, A+ modules and size charts into other languages, and keeps the original layout. Works from the final JPG or PNG files. Three free test images.

### Product Research and Pre-Launch

*   [Trends MCP](https://www.trendsmcp.ai) - MCP server and REST API with trend data from Amazon, Google Search, Google Shopping, TikTok, YouTube and other sources, for demand research in an AI assistant. Free plan with 100 requests a month. [GitHub (⭐44)](https://github.com/trendsmcp-ai/Trends-MCP)

### Other

*   [Awesome Agentic Commerce (⭐65)](https://github.com/MentionNetwork/awesome-agentic-commerce) - Curated list of agentic commerce resources: protocols (ACP, UCP, MCP), agent-readiness tools, and guides to make products visible to AI shopping agents.

items.title: Awesome Gemini Cli
items.content_text:
### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

*   [Aixle Flow (⭐31)](https://github.com/AixleHQ/flow) - Self-hosted Kanban board that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI and other coding agents, each in its own container. Moving a card starts a durable workflow with parallel steps, approval gates and per-run token and cost tracking.
